hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/guard.sh" ] && grep -qF irreversible-guard "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null; then exec bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/guard.sh"; fi; if [ -n "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/guard.sh" ] && grep -qF irreversible-guard "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null; then exec bash "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/guard.sh"; fi; if [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/guard.sh" ] && grep -qF irreversible-guard "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null; then exec bash "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/guard.sh"; fi; if [ -n "${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/guard.sh" ] && grep -qF irreversible-guard "${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null; then exec bash "${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/guard.sh"; fi; if [ -n "${MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/guard.sh" ] && grep -qF irreversible-guard "${MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null; then exec bash "${MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/guard.sh"; fi; echo "[irreversible-guard] hook target not found: hooks/guard.sh" >&2; exit 0'
